title: Two Trillion-Parameter Punches: China's AI Uppercut
description: China's Moonshot and Alibaba drop Kimi K3 and Qwen3.8 in a direct challenge to US AI leadership, prompting Trump administration talk of Chinese AI restrictions. Plus: OpenAI's secondary market resurgence, a federal push to untangle America's state AI law patchwork, and a global wave of data center moratoriums.
